structure.unit: Fisheries and Habitat of the Tidal Waters
Fishing for Oysters and Clams; Device Restrictions

law.catch_line: Theft of oysters, clams, shells, etc.; penalty
law.text: Any person who steals, or takes or carries away without permission of the owner, (i) bedded, naturally occurring, or planted oysters or clams, (ii) oysters deposited by any person making up a cargo for market, or (iii) shells or seed planted for formation of oyster or clam beds by the Commonwealth or any person, is guilty of larceny.
